from.place: Situation 05S8: the definition of a saturated multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure and its localization

title: Saturated multiplicative systems compatible with triangulation
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. A set $S$ of morphisms of $\mathcal D$ is a \emph{multiplicative system} (Stacks Categories Definition Tag 04VB) if: (MS1) every identity lies in $S$ and $S$ is closed under composition; (MS2) for $t:X\to Z$ in $S$ and $g:X\to Y$ there are $s:Y\to W$ in $S$ and $f:Z\to W$ with $s\circ g=f\circ t$, and for $s:Y\to W$ in $S$ and $f:Z\to W$ there are $t:V\to Z$ in $S$ and $g:V\to Y$ with $f\circ t=s\circ g$; (MS3) if $f,g:X\to Y$ and $t\in S$ with target $X$ satisfy $f\circ t=g\circ t$, then $s\circ f=s\circ g$ for some $s\in S$ with source $Y$, and if $s\in S$ with source $Y$ satisfies $s\circ f=s\circ g$, then $f\circ t=g\circ t$ for some $t\in S$ with target $X$. It is \emph{saturated} (Tag 04VD) if moreover (MS4) for composable morphisms $f,g,h$ with $f\circ g\in S$ and $g\circ h\in S$ one has $g\in S$. It is \emph{compatible with the triangulated structure} (Tag 05R2) if (MS5) $f\in S\iff f[1]\in S$, and (MS6) given distinguished triangles $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ and $X'\xrightarrow{u'}Y'\xrightarrow{v'}Z'\xrightarrow{w'}X'[1]$ and $s:X\to X'$, $s':Y\to Y'$ in $S$ with $s'\circ u=u'\circ s$, there is $s'':Z\to Z'$ in $S$ with $s''\circ v=v'\circ s'$ and $s[1]\circ w=w'\circ s''$. The \emph{localization} of $\mathcal D$ at $S$ is a functor $Q:\mathcal D\to S^{-1}\mathcal D$ with $Q(s)$ invertible for all $s\in S$ such that for every category $\mathcal C$ composition with $Q$ is a bijection from functors $S^{-1}\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ to functors $\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ inverting $S$, and from natural transformations between two functors $G,G':S^{-1}\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ to natural transformations $G\circ Q\to G'\circ Q$. \emph{Situation 05S8}: $\mathcal D,\mathcal D'$ are triangulated categories, $F:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D'$ is an exact functor, and $S$ is a saturated multiplicative system in $\mathcal D$ compatible with the triangulated structure. In this situation, for an object $X$ of $\mathcal D$ let $S/X$ be the category of arrows $s:X'\to X$ in $S$ (morphisms the commuting triangles); the \emph{left derived functor $LF$ is defined at $X$} (Tag 05S9) if the pro-object $S/X\to\mathcal D'$, $(s:X'\to X)\mapsto F(X')$, is essentially constant [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram], and its value $LF(X)\in\mathcal D'$ is then called the value of $LF$ at $X$.
